title: Empirical observation of negligible fairness-accuracy trade-offs in machine learning for public policy
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it was not a subject of the study. The study focuses on fairness-accuracy trade-offs in public policy contexts with respect to attributes like race, income, age, and gender.
